MovePoint Field Operations

Workforce Administration & Sales Lead Routing Platform

MovePoint is a workforce management system connecting employees, supervisors, and field representatives. It manages work schedules, monthly target tracking, leave/advance requests, deposit receipts, supervisor team audits, geographic sales lead referrals, salary details, and support tickets through an API-first Laravel backend.
